en.title: Set Total Palindrome Transformation Cost
en.description:
A string that can be rearranged into a palindrome is called palindrome-like. For any substring, characters may be changed; find the minimum number of changes needed to make it palindrome-like, and output the sum of these costs over all substrings. Rearrangement is allowed here, as the statement defines.

See below for this site's input format and constraints.
en.input: A single line containing a string s of lowercase English letters only, 1≤|s|≤100000.
en.output: Output the total palindrome-like change cost over all substrings.
en.explanation: Maintain a 26-bit parity mask for each prefix. The number of characters with odd frequency in a substring is the popcount of the XOR of two prefix masks; accumulate the XOR contributions bit by bit for each character, then subtract the odd-length terms and divide by two.
